name: gr8booksneo-automation
description: Central QA automation toolkit for Gr8Books Neo.

scripts.verify:tools: npm run check:architecture && npm run check:circular && npm run check:deadcode && npm run check:playwright
scripts.report:architecture: npm run report:prepare && npm run architecture > reports/architecture.txt 2>&1
scripts.report:circular: npm run report:prepare && npm run circular > reports/circular.txt 2>&1
scripts.report:deadcode: npm run report:prepare && npm run deadcode > reports/deadcode.txt 2>&1
scripts.qa: npm run report:architecture && npm run report:circular && npm run report:deadcode && npm run summary

author: Integr8 Software
